Needs in Afgooye were identified through a rapid assessment, analysis of HF and secondary data, and consultation with area-based coordination, MoH and the community. Medair will support 3 fixed PHC facilities (Dameraale, Tawakal and Baalguri) and 8 outreach locations. Dameraale HF is in one of the most remote and underserved areas of Afgooye District and serves as a critical service hub for surrounding hard-to-reach villages where access to essential health services is extremely limited. ltbgtBurhakaba rapid needs assessment conducted in February 2026, included KII with stakeholders, partners, communities and MoH, site visits to existing and proposed HF sites, and review of operational and security constraints. Mobile services are in place in accessible IDP locations outside the town, However, 2 locations in Wadajir area were identified as having vulnerable, severely drought affected communities with a high number of IDPs living among host families and lacking critical access to health care. Medair will establish Bulo Naseeb PHCU and Bula Tarash PHCC to address critical access gaps.lt/bgtltbrgtCore interventions include free OPD clinical consultations in line with the EPHS, Somalia STG, and IMCI. Reproductive health services will prioritize PLW, ensure fully functional BEmONC, ANC, 24-hour skilled delivery, PNC, clinical management of rape (CMR), and referral for obstetric emergencies to CEmONC, with supported transportation. Routine immunization, non-communicable disease management, and mental health consultation provided by mhGAP-HIG-trained staff will be integrated across fixed and outreach services. CHWs will deliver key health promotion messages, conduct household sensitization on available services, identify individuals needing OPD care, and strengthen linkages between communities and health facilities, support community-based disease surveillance and timely referral of suspected cases. Services will be delivered in a safe, dignified, and inclusive manner, with qualified male and female staff, private consultation spaces, and targeted measures to ensure access for women, girls, persons with disabilities, and minority groups. Women will actively participate in community engagement, feedback mechanisms, and service utilization monitoring.
